figs.name: types-of-controllers-in-instrumentation-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to choose on off, P, PI, PD or PID controller for a process loop
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to pick a controller action: on off for tolerant loops, P for small offset, PID for slow loops and PI for most loops.
figs.after_h2: Types of Controllers in Instrumentation: Introduction
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 590" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart for choosing a controller type by process need</title>
<rect width="800" height="590" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Which Controller Action Fits the Loop?</text>
<polygon points="400,62.0 600.0,110 400,158.0 200.0,110" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="105.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Small swings around</text>
<text x="400" y="127.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">setpoint acceptable?</text>
<line x1="600" y1="110" x2="640" y2="110" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="620" y="98" font-size="17" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="642" y="78" width="140" height="64" rx="10" fill="#312e81" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="712.0" y="104.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">On off</text>
<text x="712.0" y="128.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">control</text>
<line x1="400" y1="158" x2="400" y2="182" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="174" font-size="17" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="400,184.0 600.0,232 400,280.0 200.0,232" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="227.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Small offset OK,</text>
<text x="400" y="249.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">fast response needed?</text>
<line x1="600" y1="232" x2="640" y2="232" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="620" y="220" font-size="17" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="642" y="200" width="140" height="64" rx="10" fill="#4f46e5" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="712.0" y="226.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">P</text>
<text x="712.0" y="250.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">control</text>
<line x1="400" y1="280" x2="400" y2="304" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="296" font-size="17" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="400,306.0 600.0,354 400,402.0 200.0,354" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="349.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Slow process, overshoot</text>
<text x="400" y="371.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">must be reduced?</text>
<line x1="600" y1="354" x2="640" y2="354" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="620" y="342" font-size="17" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<rect x="642" y="322" width="140" height="64" rx="10" fill="#4f46e5" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="712.0" y="348.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PID</text>
<text x="712.0" y="372.3" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">control</text>
<line x1="400" y1="402" x2="400" y2="426" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="420" y="418" font-size="17" fill="#312e81" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="260" y="426" width="280" height="64" rx="10" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#4f46e5" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="452.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">PI control</text>
<text x="400.0" y="476.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">flow, level, pressure</text>
<rect x="14" y="190" width="172" height="210" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#312e81" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="100.0" y="254.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Remember</text>
<text x="100.0" y="277.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">P: keeps offset</text>
<text x="100.0" y="300.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">I: ends offset</text>
<text x="100.0" y="323.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">D: acts on rate</text>
<text x="100.0" y="346.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">D: noise prone</text>
<text x="400" y="530" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Motion and position loops that need speed and less overshoot often use PD</text>
<text x="400" y="560" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Most PLC and DCS loops are configured as PI by default</text>
</svg>

figs.name: types-of-controllers-in-instrumentation-comparison-infographic
figs.alt: types of controllers in instrumentation compared: on off, P, PI, PD and PID

<rect x="20" y="402" width="760" height="72" fill="#eef2ff" stroke="#c7d2fe"/>
